//: Fyralis BYOC private CA — step-ca PRODUCTION config. This is the prod path.
//path: The Python ca_lib.py path (root/intermediate/leaf with the SPIFFE URI SAN) is the local/testable equivalent of this; both honor the C1 cert->tenant contract: leaves carry spiffe://fyralis/tenant/<tenant_id> as a URI SAN.

db.//: step-ca's DB tracks issued/revoked serials. We additionally mirror cert->tenant into control-plane/ca/tenant_registry.json (keyed on the leaf SHA-256 fingerprint) because the auth proxy authorizes on the fingerprint+SAN, not on step-ca's internal serial DB.

authority.//: Leaves are clientAuth-only and carry the SPIFFE URI SAN. The x509 templating below stamps the tenant id into the URI SAN exactly like issue_tenant_cert() in ca_lib.py. The tenant id is supplied as the provisioner subject / a template variable at sign time.

claims.//cert-duration: default 90d leaves (matches ca_lib _LEAF_DAYS=90); short-lived so a missed revocation has a bounded blast radius.

x509.//: Hard policy: an x509 leaf may ONLY carry a SPIFFE URI SAN under the fyralis trust domain. No DNS/IP/email SANs are permitted on tenant leaves, so the auth proxy's SAN parse is unambiguous.

provisioners.name: fyralis-tenant-acme
provisioners.//: Tenant enrollment (onboarding/, P4) drives an ACME order; the order's identifier maps to the tenant id which the template stamps into the URI SAN. Tenant private keys never leave the customer VPC.

provisioners.name: fyralis-onboarding-jwk
provisioners.//: JWK provisioner for server-side issuance from the onboarding service (no ACME challenge); the onboarding service holds the provisioner private key and signs a one-time token carrying the tenant id.

key.//: PUBLIC JWK only in config; the private key lives in the onboarding service's secret store. Placeholder shown — replace at deploy time.
